The `listing` kind is the PUBLISHED site payload (publish/payload.ts). It is a different projection from `parcel`: the site's key names, plus the structured `provenance` object that replaced the bare source URL after a fixture row cited a homepage on a DENIED host.

`cheapness` / `cheapness_basis` (added 2026-08-19) are the SELECTION AXIS, published separately from `score` on purpose: publish ranks on cheapness, so a cheapness folded into the score would pin every published row at that score's maximum — measured, 500 rows tied at 100. Neither field is owner-derived; both come from parval/acreage against a cohort percentile.
